plan.summary: AI Flow Wizard: Claude-powered interactive flow builder. Users describe desired chatbot flow in natural language, AI asks clarifying questions, detects failure paths, suggests improvements, and auto-generates FlowConfigV2 with preview and diff view.
plan.q_intent: Flow builder ana sayfasına bir düğme ekle. Amaç yeni akış için kullanıcıdan aklındakini almak, detaylandırmak, açıkları bulmak, daha iyi nasıl olur öneriler yapmak ve sonunda bu akışı otomatik olarak oluşturmak.
plan.interview_notes: UI: Full page route /wizard/:flowId. Model: Sonnet 4.6 default, Opus optional. Transport: SSE. Context: Full (existing flows + node types). Preview: Mini canvas with diff. Storage: wizard_history JSONB column. Persistence: Auto-save + resume. Aha features: #1 Failure-path forcing, #2 Node explanation chips, #3 Existing flow overlap detection, #5 Diff view.

verification_questions.question: Does the SSE streaming endpoint properly flush chunks and handle client disconnection without leaving orphan tasks?
Is the Claude API key never exposed in frontend code, SSE responses, or git-tracked config files?
Does the wizard_history JSONB column handle null, empty array, and large conversation histories without data corruption?
Are all wizard endpoints properly authenticated with JWT and tenant-scoped to prevent cross-tenant data access?
Does the FlowConfigV2 extraction from Claude response handle malformed JSON, missing fields, and invalid node types gracefully?

user_facing_errors: AI yanit suresi doldu. Lutfen tekrar deneyin.
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks either set error state visible to user or log warnings. The JsonException catch in SSE parsing intentionally skips malformed lines (standard SSE practice) but does not lose the stream.

aha_moments.user_pain: Users create flows with dead-end paths (no fallback for unrecognized intents, empty condition branches)
aha_moments.suggestion: Failure-path forcing: AI analyzes all branches before generating flow, asks about missing handlers
aha_moments.aha_moment: User realizes AI caught 3 missing error paths they would have missed manually

aha_moments.user_pain: Users don't understand what node types like ai_intent or logic_switch mean in chat context
aha_moments.suggestion: NodeChip: hoverable inline badges in chat messages with Turkish descriptions and category colors
aha_moments.aha_moment: User hovers over 'ai_intent' chip and immediately understands what it does without leaving the conversation

aha_moments.user_pain: Users accidentally create flows that duplicate functionality of existing active flows
aha_moments.suggestion: Overlap detection: AI sees all tenant flows in context and warns about functional overlap
aha_moments.aha_moment: AI says 'You already have a customer greeting flow - should this replace it or handle a different scenario?'

aha_moments.user_pain: Users can't see what changed between AI iterations of the flow design
aha_moments.suggestion: Diff view: green/amber/red ring highlighting on preview canvas nodes showing added/modified/removed
aha_moments.aha_moment: User sees green rings on 3 new nodes and amber on 1 modified node, instantly understanding what AI changed

aha_moments.user_pain: Support team can't understand why a flow was designed a certain way months later
aha_moments.suggestion: AI History tab in flow settings showing the full conversation that led to the flow's creation
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support opens AI History tab and sees the exact user decisions that shaped each node choice

verdict.note: Q FORCE PASS: 3/6 chunks PASS, 3/6 false positives (cross-chunk UNKNOWN, scope complaints on allowed_files, TS catch patterns)
